description: Pages when ONE camera has reported no motion for 72h while the rest of the fleet is active. The existing fleet-wide dead-man only fires when EVERY camera goes quiet, so a single camera whose motion detection dies is invisible to it - that blind spot hid a dead camera for a week (found 2026-08-04 by log review, not by monitoring). Source is the recorder, not entity last_changed, so an HA restart cannot mask staleness.

data.title: 📷 Camera not detecting motion
